wordmark.purpose: App name in the top bar at 700.

label.purpose: Buttons, steps, tabs, field labels at 0.875rem.

caption.purpose: Champion names under tiles, patch chip, tags at 0.75rem.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: A token lands on its slot (state change: slot filled).

motion.name: slide-in
motion.purpose: Step changes. Both motions disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one yellow action per screen (Next, View build, New match).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffd23f; color: #1d1a05; font: 700 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .4; }

components.name: Stepper Step
components.description: Three-part progress control; current step has a marker border and yellow number disc.
components.css: .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; width: 160px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 243 234 / .18); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: #a9c0b0; font: 600 .875rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step-cur { border-color: #ffd23f; color: #eef3ea; } .ds-disc { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(238 243 234 / .18); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-cur .ds-disc { background: #ffd23f; color: #1d1a05; border-color: #ffd23f; } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Full-width champion search; border turns marker yellow on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input placeholder="Buscar campeón"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 243 234 / .18); border-radius: 12px; background: #143626; color: #a9c0b0; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #ffd23f; } .ds-search input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; outline: 0; color: #eef3ea; caret-color: #ffd23f; font: 400 1rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #a9c0b0; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Segmented rail for build views; active tab is solid marker yellow.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 243 234 / .18); border-radius: 12px; background: #143626; } .ds-tab { height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #a9c0b0; font: 600 .875rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-on { background: #ffd23f; color: #1d1a05; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Outlined pill for patch and type labels.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(238 243 234 / .18); border-radius: 9999px; color: #a9c0b0; font: 600 .75rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Token
components.description: Magnetic champion token: circle with side-colored ring; drops on placement.
components.html: AR
components.css: .ds-token { display: inline-flex; margin-right: 12px; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-drop 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-token-img { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1b4631; color: #eef3ea; font: 700 1.25rem 'Barlow Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: none; } .ds-token-ally .ds-token-img { outline: 3px solid #5ab0ff; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-token-foe .ds-token-img { outline: 3px solid #ff6a57; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-token-empty { border: 2px dashed rgb(238 243 234 / .18); animation: none; box-sizing: border-box; } @keyframes ds-drop { 0% { transform: scale(1.18); } 60% { transform: scale(.95); } 100% { transform: scale(1); } }

narrative.overview: A dark bottle-green felt with chalk-white type and 1px chalk lines. The match is laid out like a magnet board: your champion and the five rivals are circular tokens, the build is read as a numbered play. Navigation is standard (stepper, tabs, bottom dock) but dressed in the board's colors. Phone-first, one-handed; every tap target is at least 40px.
keyCharacteristics: Felt ground, one step lighter panels, chalk lines at 18% opacity
Circular portrait tokens with a team-colored ring and a lane glyph badge
One condensed sans (Barlow Semi Condensed), tabular numerals globally
Lucide line icons (stroke 2), plus a hand-drawn pitch mark as the logo
One authored motion: the token drop

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Marker yellow appears only on the primary action and the current selection (step, tab, focus, active slot). It never decorates.

rules.name: The Side Color Rule
rules.body: Blue means ally, red means rival, and they appear only as token rings and side indicators.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere (set on body) so stats and prices align.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation is a felt step or a 1px chalk line, never a shadow.

dos: Do use Marker Yellow only for the primary action and the current selection.
Do ring tokens in blue for allies and red for rivals.
Do separate surfaces with a felt step or a Chalk Line border.
Do use Lucide line icons at stroke 2 and the lane glyph set wherever a lane appears.
Do keep tap targets at 40px or more and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do reserve the drop for a slot being filled; the slide-in is for step changes only.
donts: Don't return to the dark-gold card dashboard with emoji headers.
Don't use shadows, gradients, or card grids for content.
Don't use blue or red for anything other than team side.
